name: superseded_command_forwarded__observed
regression: The propagation allowance of fresh_output is bounded: an output that keeps a source's replaced command longer than the freshness grace (0.05 s) is a stale command forwarded, even though the source never went silent.
initial_conditions: Synthetic GO2 + HELIX run (6.5 s): /nav/cmd_vel at 20 Hz commands 0.15 m/s from t=2 s; the recorded /cmd_vel follows each command 2 to 5 ms later.
injected_fault: From t=4.0 s the navigation source commands 0.1 m/s, but the recorded /cmd_vel keeps 0.15 m/s to the end.
